# E2E Cloud Provider

~> **Important Migration Notice**: This provider is migrating to standardized parameter names in v3.0.0. All deprecated parameters in v2.x will be removed in v3.0.0. See the [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](guides/upgrade-to-v3.md) for migration instructions.

Use the e2e provider to interact with the many resources supported by E2E. You must configure the provider with the proper credentials before you can use it.

You can use e2e terraform provider to create resources.
Use the navigation to the left to read about the available resources.

## Example Usage

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    e2e = {
      source  = "e2eterraformprovider/e2e"
      version = "~> 2.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "e2e" {
  api_key         = var.e2e_api_key    # Or use E2E_API_KEY environment variable
  auth_token      = var.e2e_auth_token # Or use E2E_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable
  default_region  = "Delhi NCR"        # Optional: Set default for all resources
  default_project_id = "12345"          # Optional: Set default for all resources
}

# Resources can omit region/project_id when provider defaults are set
resource "e2e_node" "node1" {
  name = "web-server"
  plan = "C3.8GB"
  image = "Ubuntu-22.04"
  # region and project_id inherit from provider defaults
}

# Resources can still override defaults when needed
resource "e2e_node" "node2" {
  name       = "mumbai-server"
  region     = "Mumbai"  # Overrides provider default
  project_id = "67890"   # Overrides provider default
  plan       = "C3.8GB"
  image      = "Ubuntu-22.04"
}
```

## v3.0.0 Migration Quick Reference

| Deprecated (v2.x)          | New (v3.0.0)           | Affected Resources           |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `location`                 | `region`               | All resources & data sources |
| `project_id` (int)         | `project_id` (string)  | Block Storage, Kubernetes    |
| `plan_id`/`sku_id` (input) | `plan_name` (computed) | Autoscaling                  |
| `creation_time`            | `created_at`           | Image                        |
| `setup_status`             | `status`               | Container Registry           |

→ **See [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](guides/upgrade-to-v3.md) for complete migration details**

## Environment Setup

Set these environment variables for provider configuration:

```bash
export E2E_API_KEY="your-api-key"
export E2E_AUTH_TOKEN="your-auth-token"
export E2E_REGION="Delhi NCR"  # Optional: Default region for all resources
export E2E_PROJECT_ID="12345"  # Optional: Default project ID for all resources
export E2E_API_ENDPOINT="https://api.e2enetworks.com/myaccount/api/v1/"  # Optional
```

Test your configuration:

```bash
terraform plan
```

## Schema

### Argument Reference

- `api_key` - (Required) (String) Valid API key required. Alternatively, this can be specified using the `E2E_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `auth_token` - (Required) (String) Valid authentication Bearer token required. Alternatively, this can be specified using the `E2E_AUTH_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `api_endpoint` - (Optional) (String) Specify the endpoint. Default endpoint is `https://api.e2enetworks.com/myaccount/api/v1/`. Alternatively, this can be specified using the `E2E_API_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `default_region` - (Optional) (String) Default region for all resources. Can be overridden per-resource. Can also be set via `E2E_REGION` environment variable.
- `default_project_id` - (Optional) (String) Default project ID for all resources. Can be overridden per-resource. Can also be set via `E2E_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
